title: Diamagnetic Properties of Doped Antiferromagnets
abstract: Finite-temperature diamagnetic properties of doped antiferromagnets as modeled by the two-dimensional t-J model were investigated by numerical studies of small model systems. Two numerical methods were used: the worldline quantum Monte Carlo method with a loop cluster algorithm (QMC) and the finite-temperature Lanczos method (FTLM), yielding consistent results. The diamagnetic susceptibility introduced by coupling of the magnetic field to the orbital current reveals an anomalous temperature dependence, changing character from diamagnetic to paramagnetic at intermediate temperatures.
